events.name: Sagra della Vongola (Clam Festival), Torvaianica
events.when: annually in summer (recent editions in July/August); typically spread over two weekends with seafood, music and stalls in the Torvaianica seafront area
events.blurb: Long-running seafood food festival in Torvaianica dedicated to the local clam (vongola lupino), organised by the Pro Loco with the Municipality of Pomezia, featuring seafood dishes, live music, craft stalls and entertainment.

events.name: Festa di Maria Assunta in Cielo & Sea Procession, Torvaianica
events.when: annually mid-August (around 14-17 August); the historic sea procession is on 15 August (Feast of the Assumption)
events.blurb: Torvaianica's patronal feast, run by the Beata Vergine Immacolata parish with the Municipality of Pomezia. Its centerpiece is the historic sea procession on 15 August, when fishermen carry the Madonna's statue by boat off the Torvaianica coast, accompanied by concerts, food stands, fireworks and children's games.

events.name: Ostia Festival (Ostia in Rosa + Ostia Jazz Festival), Lido di Ostia
events.when: annually late May to early June; 2026 edition 29 May - 2 June
events.blurb: A multi-day festival on the Roman coast in Piazza Anco Marzio, Lido di Ostia. It pairs comedy evenings (Ostia in Rosa, 29-30 May 2026 with Gabriele Cirilli and Antonio Giuliani, tied to the Giro d'Italia passing through) with the Ostia Jazz Festival (31 May - 2 June 2026), promoted by the Alexanderplatz Jazz Club.

events.name: Ostia Summer Jam, Teatro del Lido di Ostia
events.when: annually in spring (12th edition in 2026, on 16 May 2026 from 2 PM)
events.blurb: A hip-hop culture festival at the Teatro del Lido di Ostia exploring breaking, battles and visual arts, with workshops, urban clothing and merchandise stands and a dedicated graffiti area. The 2026 edition is its 12th.

events.name: Sagra del Mandorlo in Fiore (Almond Blossom Festival)
events.when: annually in early-to-mid March; 2026 edition (78th) runs 7-15 March
events.blurb: International folklore festival in Agrigento celebrating the almond blossom and themes of peace and friendship among peoples, with parades of folk groups from around the world through the city and the UNESCO-listed Valley of the Temples, including the lighting of the Friendship Tripod and a drone show.

events.name: Festa di San Calogero
events.when: annually during the first two weeks of July
events.blurb: Agrigento's major patron-saint festival honouring San Calogero (the 'Santo Nero'), with processions of the statue through the historic centre, the traditional throwing of sesame 'muffuletti' rolls, the Sagra del Grano with a parade of Sicilian carts, and the 'Ntinna' pole-climbing game held at Piazzale Giglia in San Leone.

events.name: FestiValle
events.when: annually in early August; 2026 edition (10th) runs 7-10 August
events.blurb: International music and digital-arts festival staged across the Valley of the Temples, with concerts, DJ sets and site-specific performances. The companion 'FestiValle Beach' runs daily (around midday to 4 PM) on San Leone beach with DJ sets by the river and sea.

events.name: One May Village
events.blurb: Labour Day village event held at San Leone featuring live music, sport and other recreational activities along the seafront.

events.name: Vela Day (Sailing Day) - Punta Piccola Nautical Club season opening
events.when: annually in early June, opening the summer season at San Leone
events.blurb: Traditional sailing day organised by the Punta Piccola nautical club in San Leone under the Italian Sailing Federation, marking the official start of the summer season.

events.name: Festa Patronale di San Nicandro Garganico (Patron Saints Festival)
events.blurb: The main patronal festival of San Nicandro Garganico, honouring patron saints San Nicandro, San Marciano and Santa Daria. Combines a solemn religious procession with the town band, plus concerts (2026 headliner Elettra Lamborghini) and pyromusical fireworks.

events.name: Carnevale Storico Sannicandrese (Historic Carnival)
events.when: annually in February (Carnival season); 2026 edition ran 8-22 February with parades on 8, 15 and 17 Feb
events.blurb: Long-running historic carnival of San Nicandro Garganico featuring large allegorical float parades and masked groups through the town, plus the traditional 'Pastore e Pacchiana' historic procession, food & wine route and the closing 'Quarantana' ritual.

events.name: Estate Sannicandrese (San Nicandro Summer Festival)
events.when: annually July-August; programme includes events at Torre Mileto
events.blurb: Town-run summer programme of open-air concerts, theatre, art exhibitions and outdoor cinema, with several events staged at the Torre Mileto coastal locality and the floodlit Aragonese tower opened for visits.

events.name: Festival itinerante dei Suonatori di Tarantelle del Gargano
events.when: annually in summer; performances staged at Torre Mileto
events.blurb: Itinerant festival of traditional Gargano tarantella players, with folk-music groups such as Tarantula Garganica and Cantatori del Gargano performing, including dates at Torre Mileto.

events.name: Sagra delle Anguille di Lesina (Lesina Eel Festival)
events.when: annually, typically December, in nearby Lesina on the Lesina lagoon
events.blurb: Founded in 2004, this gastronomy festival in the nearby lagoon town of Lesina celebrates the local Slow Food presidium eel, served in many traditional preparations, drawing thousands of visitors. Held in the Lesina lagoon area adjacent to the Torre Mileto coastal strip.

events.name: Poetto Fest
events.when: annually late May / early June at the Opera Beach Arena on Poetto beach; 2026 edition 29 May - 1 June
events.blurb: Music festival held directly on the sand of Poetto beach at the Opera Beach Arena, with several nights of Italian pop, urban, trap and Latin acts facing the sea. The 2026 (8th) edition runs 29 May to 1 June with headliners such as Ernia and Kid Yugi.

events.name: Festa di Sant'Efisio
events.when: annually 1-4 May in Cagliari; 2026 edition (370th) 1-4 May
events.blurb: Sardinia's largest religious and folk celebration, dating from a 1652 vow against the plague. A multi-day procession brings thousands in traditional dress, folk groups, horsemen and decorated carts through Cagliari toward Nora. The 2026 edition is the 370th.

events.name: Cagliari Triathlon (Poetto)
events.when: annually in May at Poetto beach; 2026 races held the weekend of 16-17 May
events.blurb: Triathlon event that turns Poetto beach and the Marina Piccola area into an open-air arena, with swimming, cycling and running courses along the waterfront and hundreds of competing athletes.

events.name: Sagra Estiva di Nostra Signora di Bonaria (Sea Procession)
events.when: annually on the first Sunday of July in Cagliari
events.blurb: Summer feast of the patroness of Sardinia, held since 1866. After Mass at the Bonaria Basilica, the statue of the Madonna is carried to the port and taken out to sea in a procession of dozens of boats to Su Siccu, where a wreath is cast into the water in memory of lost sailors.

events.name: Marina Cafe Noir
events.when: annually in summer in the Cagliari area (festival of applied literatures); 2026 edition 19-21 June
events.blurb: Long-running festival of 'applied literatures' founded in Cagliari in 2003, blending literature, music and performance with free public events. Editions have been held in the historic Marina district and at Poetto; the 2026 edition is staged at Elmas, just outside Cagliari, from 19 to 21 June.

events.name: Festa di San Pietro al Golgo
events.when: annually on the last weekend of June (procession from Baunei up to the San Pietro church on the Golgo plateau); 2026 edition on 27-28 June
events.blurb: Centuries-old religious feast where the faithful climb in procession from Baunei to the isolated San Pietro church on the Golgo plateau above Cala Goloritze, tied to the legend of Saint Peter and 'Sa Serpente', with traditional Sardinian rites.

events.name: Sagra della Carne di Capra (Goat Meat Festival)
events.when: annually in summer in Baunei / Santa Maria Navarrese (editions held in late June and again in August); long-running festival, over 40 editions
events.blurb: Long-standing food festival in Baunei celebrating local goat meat, with tastings, the traditional wood-oven 'Pistoccu' bread, live music and Sardinian folk dancing in the square.

events.name: Sagra del Maialetto (Sa Sagra de Coppieddu - Roast Suckling Pig Festival)
events.when: annually in the last week of July, in Piazza Bingigedda, Baunei (typically a Saturday around 25-26 July)
events.blurb: Baunei's traditional roast suckling pig (porceddu) festival, where visitors enjoy the slow-roasted pork with wine, pecorino cheese and carasau bread, accompanied by traditional Sardinian dances.

events.name: Festa di Santa Maria Assunta
events.when: annually on 13-15 August at Santa Maria Navarrese (frazione of Baunei), centred on 15 August (Assumption)
events.blurb: The main patronal feast of Santa Maria Navarrese: a three-day celebration with a procession of the Madonna from Baunei, a spectacular maritime procession of decorated boats across the Gulf of Arbatax, mass in the seaside stone amphitheatre, plus live music, folk dances and craft and food stalls.

events.name: Baunei Hiking Festival
events.when: annually, typically in October, based in Baunei and along the Supramonte / Golfo di Orosei coast
events.blurb: An autumn outdoor festival of guided hikes and treks exploring the rugged Supramonte mountains and the Gulf of Orosei coastline around Baunei, including trails toward Cala Goloritze.

events.name: Barcarolata
events.blurb: A traditional nighttime water parade held right in the Baia del Silenzio, where boats decorated with papier-mache and lights compete in a creative procession, concluding with a fireworks display over the bay. The event dates back to the 1960s.

events.name: Andersen Festival
events.blurb: Sestri Levante's annual festival of theatre, storytelling, music and street art, themed in 2026 around 'the Present'. It is tied to the historic Premio Andersen fairy-tale award, reflecting the town's nickname 'Baia delle Favole' (Bay of Fables), the cove adjacent to the Baia del Silenzio.

events.name: Rassegna Internazionale del Folclore Citta di Arzachena
events.blurb: An international folklore showcase held every 13 August in the streets of Arzachena for over two decades, featuring traditional dance and music groups and drawing thousands of locals and tourists.

events.name: Festival delle Fisarmoniche
events.blurb: A festival in Arzachena dedicated to the accordion, an instrument central to traditional Sardinian dance music and song, held each year on 18 August.

events.name: Festa Patronale di San Giovanni Battista (Cannigione - Gulf of Arzachena)
events.blurb: The patron-saint festival of Cannigione and the Gulf of Arzachena, blending religion, folklore and food with a seaside procession and the traditional propitiatory fire-jumping ritual.

events.name: Arzachena Summer Festival (Estate ad Arzachena)
events.blurb: Arzachena's official summer programme of more than 60 events spanning the town centre, the villages and resorts like Baja Sardinia, with concerts, cultural appointments, sport and traditional festivals.

events.name: Grey Cat Festival
events.blurb: Long-running Tuscan jazz festival (over 45 editions) staged across Maremma towns, with concerts held in Scarlino at the Rocca Pisana castle. It is co-promoted by the municipality of Scarlino alongside Follonica, Grosseto and other Maremma towns.

events.name: Le Carriere del Diciannove
events.blurb: Historical folklore festival in Scarlino commemorating the town's 1855 deliverance from a cholera epidemic, featuring contrade in Renaissance costume competing in a relay race (carriera) and archery at the Rocca. The celebration also includes a procession for the Beato Tommaso (Beato Tomma).

events.name: Sagra del Pesce
events.blurb: Traditional fish festival held in Scarlino celebrating local seafood, part of the town's summer-into-autumn calendar of community events.

events.name: Festa di Sant'Anna (Quercianella patron saint feast)
events.blurb: Quercianella's patron saint feast honours Sant'Anna, celebrated on 26 July when the parish community gathers in Piazza Fattori and processes to the garden of the Suore Passioniste.

events.name: Effetto Venezia
events.blurb: Livorno's flagship summer festival animates the historic Venezia canal district with live music, shows, markets and lights; the 41st edition runs 29 July to 2 August 2026 with artists including The Kolors and Ron.

events.name: Cacciucco Pride
events.blurb: A Livorno food festival celebrating cacciucco, the city's iconic fish stew, with local restaurants serving themed menus alongside music and cultural events; the 2025 edition ran 22-24 August.

events.name: Quercianella Run
events.blurb: A non-competitive running event in Quercianella with 18, 12 and 6 km routes through the hills and along the coast, starting from Via del Littorale.

events.name: Cala Gonone Jazz Festival
events.blurb: Long-running seaside jazz festival in Cala Gonone, the coastal village of Dorgali, reaching its 39th edition in 2026 with leading names from the Italian and international jazz scene.

events.name: Sagra del Pesce / Festa della Madonna del Mare
events.blurb: Decades-old fish festival on the port square of Cala Gonone, where the Pro Loco of Dorgali serves fried fish from a giant pan alongside local wines, cheeses and sweets, an artisan market, Sardinian dances and folklore.

events.name: Ferragosto Dorgalese - Processione dell'Assunta
events.blurb: Traditional Feast of the Assumption in Dorgali and Cala Gonone, with a religious procession plus folkloric events and celebrations across the mid-August period.

events.name: Autunno in Barbagia
events.when: annually in autumn (Sept-Dec, set weekend for Dorgali)
events.blurb: Itinerant autumn festival across the Barbagia region of Sardinia in which Dorgali opens its courtyards, workshops and homes to showcase local crafts, food and traditions.

events.name: Cala Gonone Jazz Festival
events.when: annually mid-July to early August (2026: 9 July - 1 August)
events.blurb: Long-running seaside jazz festival held in Cala Gonone, the coastal village of Dorgali nearest to Cala Luna, with concerts including some in the Bue Marino caves. The 2026 edition is its 39th, running 9 July to 1 August.

events.name: Fire of Sant'Antonio Abate
events.blurb: Traditional Sardinian bonfire feast honoring Saint Anthony the Abbot, lit on the night of 16 January in Dorgali. The local fire uses only rosemary ('Su Romasinu') for its distinctive fragrance, and children try to grab oranges before the flames.

events.name: Ferragosto Dorgalese (Processione dell'Assunta)
events.blurb: Assumption Day (Ferragosto) celebration in Dorgali featuring the procession of the Assunta. A major mid-August religious and community event near Cala Luna.

events.name: Autunno in Barbagia (Dorgali)
events.blurb: Regional autumn cultural circuit in which Dorgali opens its courtyards, workshops and craft and food traditions to visitors. Part of the wider Barbagia autumn open-house program.

cala-sisine.town: Baunei (Cala Sisine is in the municipality of Baunei; nearest coastal town/frazione is Santa Maria Navarrese)

events.name: Sagra del Maialetto (Suckling Pig Festival)
events.blurb: Baunei's most popular food festival, held in Piazza Bingigedda in the village centre, serving slow-roasted Sardinian suckling pig with local cheese, pane carasau and red wine, followed by traditional music and dancing. The XXII edition is scheduled for 18 July 2026, organised by the Pro Loco of Baunei and Santa Maria Navarrese.

events.name: Sagra della Carne di Capra (Goat Meat Festival)
events.when: annually in the second half of August (around Ferragosto)
events.blurb: A long-running festival in Santa Maria Navarrese (Baunei's coastal frazione, near Cala Sisine), now in its 40-plus editions, where spit-roasted goat meat is served at communal tables in Piazza Principessa di Navarra near the beach. It traces back to the tradition of welcoming pilgrims arriving for Ferragosto.

events.name: Festa di San Pietro
events.blurb: Baunei's patron saint festival, with religious processions accompanying the statue of Saint Peter through the village and out to the Golgo plain, alongside parades of traditional Sardinian costumes and horses.

events.name: Sagra dei Culurgiones
events.blurb: A festival in Baunei celebrating culurgiones, the hand-pleated stuffed pasta that is one of Ogliastra's gastronomic specialities, served with traditional music and local conviviality.

events.name: Le Carriere del 19
events.blurb: A historical and folkloric reenactment in the medieval village of Scarlino, commemorating the end of an 1855 cholera epidemic. Held over three days culminating on 19 August, the town's districts (Centro, Rocca, San Donato) compete in costumed processions, archery, flag-throwing and a relay foot race that gives the festival its name.

events.name: Festa di San Martino di Tours (Patron Saint Feast)
events.blurb: Scarlino celebrates its patron saint, San Martino di Tours, at the village's Church of San Martino with a Holy Mass, the traditional blessing of the new wine, and community refreshments featuring local products. The feast is a key moment of local identity and tradition.

events.name: Sagra del Marrone (Chestnut Festival)
events.blurb: An autumn food festival in Scarlino celebrating the local marrone chestnut, with roasted chestnuts, typical Maremma dishes and stalls, often coinciding with end-of-October Halloween festivities in the village.

events.name: Sagra del Pesce di Piombino
events.blurb: A long-running seafood festival held on Piazza Bovio, the seafront terrace overlooking the sea, famous for a giant frying pan (about 2.5 meters across) in which fish is fried in around 120 kg of oil on the closing night. Specialties include boiled octopus and anchovies in pesto.

events.name: Festa della Palamita
events.blurb: A gastronomic festival celebrating the palamita (bonito), a blue fish typical of the Tuscan coast, with tasting stands of local dishes paired with wines from the Tuscan hills. It is one of the area's most appreciated food events.

events.name: Festa di Sant'Anastasia (Palio degli Arcieri)
events.blurb: Piombino celebrates its patron saint Sant'Anastasia on May 8 with religious services in the Concattedrale di Sant'Antimo and a historical medieval reenactment, the Palio degli Arcieri (archery tournament), a tradition rooted in a 1472 decree of the city's Council of Elders.

events.name: Infiorata di Noto
events.blurb: Noto's famous flower festival, where Via Corrado Nicolaci is covered in an enormous carpet made entirely of flower petals. The 2026 edition runs May 15-19 with a Pop Culture theme.

events.name: Festival del Pesce Azzurro (Blue Fish Festival)
events.blurb: A four-day food festival in the fishing village of Marzamemi celebrating blue fish (sardines, anchovies, mackerel) with tastings, cooking shows, stands of local producers, and evening live music.

events.name: Feast of St. Francis of Paola (Festa di San Francesco di Paola)
events.blurb: Marzamemi's patronal festival honoring the patron saint of fishermen, featuring a maritime procession, live music, and fireworks.

events.name: Rassegna del Folklore di Arzachena (International Folklore Festival)
events.blurb: A long-running folklore showcase held every 13 August in Arzachena, gathering folk groups from across Sardinia to present traditional music, dance and costumes, accompanied by Gallura and Sardinian food specialities.

events.name: Festa dei Santi Patroni di Arzachena (Sant'Antonio, Sant'Isidoro e Maria della Neve)
events.blurb: Arzachena's patron saint festival honouring Sant'Antonio, Sant'Isidoro and Maria della Neve, with religious processions plus an entertainment programme of concerts and events held in the town centre.

events.name: Carnevale di Arzachena (Lu Carrasciali Alzachinesu)
events.blurb: Arzachena's traditional carnival features allegorical floats and masked groups parading through the town and the villages of Porto Cervo and Cannigione, with music and local sweets such as frittelle.

events.name: Rally Costa Smeralda Storico
events.blurb: A historic-car regularity rally based in the Costa Smeralda / Arzachena area, with the 9th edition scheduled for 24-25 April 2026.

events.name: Infiorata di Noto (Noto Flower Festival)
events.when: annually the third weekend of May (2026: May 15-19)
events.blurb: Noto's famous flower festival fills Via Corrado Nicolaci with elaborate floral carpets created by master artists; the 47th edition runs May 15-19, 2026 on the theme 'Pop Culture Tells Its Story'. It regularly draws over 200,000 visitors.

events.name: Festa di San Corrado (Summer Feast)
events.when: annually the last Sunday of August
events.blurb: Noto's patron saint San Corrado Confalonieri is celebrated with a procession of the silver urn holding his relics through the Baroque town, accompanied by traditional 'cilii' candle-bearers and the Fair of San Corrado. The summer feast commemorates his beatification.

events.name: Festa di San Corrado (Winter Feast)
events.blurb: The winter feast of Noto's patron saint marks the death of the hermit San Corrado, with a procession of his silver reliquary urn carried on bearers' shoulders, preceded by confraternities and decorative 'cilii' candles.

events.name: Sicily Music Festival & Competition
events.blurb: An international music festival and competition held in Noto, scheduled for July 12-20, 2026, bringing classical and other musical performances to the Baroque town near Eloro Beach.

events.name: Sagra del Polpo di Tellaro (Octopus Festival)
events.blurb: Tellaro's famous octopus festival commemorates a local legend in which an octopus rang the church bell to warn villagers of a pirate raid; the seaside village serves octopus dishes and hosts celebrations.

events.name: Lerici Music Festival 2026
events.blurb: Annual classical music festival in Lerici and the Gulf of Poets, with concerts, opera and multimedia performances staged at venues such as Villa Marigola, churches and outdoor spaces. The 2026 edition runs July 22 to August 2.

events.name: Notte Romantica nei Borghi piu Belli d'Italia (Tellaro)
events.when: annually in June; 2026 edition on June 20
events.blurb: Tellaro, one of the Borghi piu Belli d'Italia, takes part in the nationwide Romantic Night with evening events and a romantic atmosphere in the historic village near Fiascherino.

events.name: Festa di San Giorgio (Tellaro patron saint)
events.blurb: Tellaro celebrates its patron saint San Giorgio with a traditional feast day on April 23.

events.name: P.I.G. (Pesce In Gallura)
events.blurb: Three-day food, wine and seafood festival in Piazza della Liberta and the historic center of Santa Teresa Gallura, with local fish products, marine workshops, live music and DJ sets. The 8th edition runs 30 May to 1 June 2026.

events.name: Gallura Buskers Festival
events.blurb: International street-performance festival bringing artists from around the world to Santa Teresa Gallura for free shows of juggling, acrobatics, magic, clowning, aerial acts, music and street theater. The 14th edition takes place 9 to 12 July 2026.

events.name: Festa Patronale di Santa Teresa Gallura
events.blurb: The town's patronal feast honors its three patron saints, San Vittorio (14 October), Santa Teresa d'Avila (15 October) and Sant'Isidoro (16 October), with processions, masses and community celebrations.

events.name: Sant Miquel Festival
events.blurb: Alghero's patron saint festival honouring St Michael, running about two weeks in September with religious rites, concerts, theatre, exhibitions and food-and-wine events culminating on the saint's day.

events.name: Cap d'Any de l'Alguer
events.blurb: Alghero's long-running Christmas and New Year programme with a Santa Claus village, Christmas market, ice rink and major concerts at Piazzale della Pace around 29-31 December.

events.name: JazzAlguer
events.blurb: International jazz festival held across Alghero's countryside and historic venues (Nuraghe Palmavera, Sella & Mosca, Santa Maria La Palma), spread over roughly seven months from spring to autumn.

events.name: Feast of St John the Baptist (St John's Fires)
events.blurb: Midsummer celebration marking the start of the season, with bonfires lit on the beach near Alghero, food-and-wine stalls and concerts.

events.name: Festival Puccini (Puccini Opera Festival)
events.when: annually mid-July to early September; 2026: 17 July - 5 September
events.blurb: Annual open-air opera festival held at the Gran Teatro Giacomo Puccini in Torre del Lago, beside Lake Massaciuccoli near Lecciona beach. The 72nd edition runs from 17 July to 5 September 2026, staging Puccini works including Turandot, Tosca, La Boheme and Madama Butterfly.

events.name: Carnevale di Viareggio (Viareggio Carnival)
events.blurb: One of Italy's most famous carnivals, held in nearby Viareggio with giant papier-mache allegorical floats parading along the seafront promenade. The 2026 edition runs across six masked parades from 1 to 21 February.

events.name: Torre Pride Fest (Marina di Torre del Lago)
events.blurb: A queer summer festival that turns the Marina district of Torre del Lago, long established as an Italian gay-friendly resort near Lecciona beach, into a month-long rainbow village with club nights, drag shows and events centered on the Mamamia venue.

events.name: Feast of the Madonna della Consolazione
events.when: annually, second Saturday of September (four days)
events.blurb: Reggio Calabria's main religious and civic celebration, honoring the city's beloved patroness. A sacred painting of the Madonna is carried in procession on a five-metre shoulder-borne 'Vara' from the Basilica dell'Eremo to the Cathedral, accompanied by masses, music and food festivals over four days.

events.name: Bergare - Festival del Bergamotto
events.blurb: An annual festival held at the Castello Aragonese in Reggio Calabria celebrating bergamot, the citrus symbol of Calabria. Promoted by the local Chamber of Commerce, it features tastings, talks and events along the Lungomare Falcomata waterfront.

events.name: ReggioFest
events.blurb: A diffused-culture festival across Reggio Calabria featuring major concerts, urban theatre and live entertainment in public squares such as Piazza del Popolo.

lido-di-pomposa.town: Comacchio (Lidi di Comacchio / Lidi Ferraresi), Province of Ferrara, Emilia-Romagna

events.name: Carnevale d'Estate - Compleanno dei Lidi Pomposa e Scacchi (Summer Carnival)
events.blurb: A summer carnival held every 8 August to celebrate the 'birthday' of Lido di Pomposa and the neighbouring Lido degli Scacchi, with the allegorical floats of the Carnevale di Pitoch parading along the seafront, music and entertainment, ending in a midnight fireworks display over the sea.

events.name: La Notte Rosa - Hit's Summer (Riviera di Comacchio)
events.blurb: The Emilia-Romagna coast's 'Pink Night' kick-off, with the 2026 'Hit's Summer' edition bringing three nights of free open-air concerts (including artists such as LDA, Aka7even and Fred De Palma at the nearby Lido degli Scacchi), DJ sets, light shows and fireworks across the Comacchio beaches.

events.name: Sagra dell'Anguilla (Eel Festival), Comacchio
events.when: annually late September to mid-October (2026: 26-28 Sep, 2-5 Oct, 10-12 Oct)
events.blurb: Comacchio's renowned eel festival, held over several autumn weekends in the historic town centre near the Trepponti bridge and the Manifattura dei Marinati, with traditional roasted eel and lagoon fish dishes, wine tastings, markets, concerts and guided excursions.

events.name: Mercatino serale del lunedì (Monday Evening Market), Lido di Pomposa
events.when: Monday evenings, early June to early September
events.blurb: A weekly evening street market held on Mondays through the summer season at Lido di Pomposa, with stalls along the resort offering local crafts, clothing and food.

events.name: Festa di San Giacomo (Patron Saint Festival)
events.blurb: Orosei's main patron-saint feast honouring San Giacomo (Saint James), featuring a religious procession, parades of traditional Sardinian costumes, folk performances, poetry competitions in Sardinian, fireworks and food stands. It is the town's most important annual celebration.

events.name: Sardinia World Chess Festival
events.blurb: An international open chess festival held at the Club Hotel Marina Beach in Orosei, drawing hundreds of players from dozens of countries; the 2026 third edition featured top grandmasters and a prize fund of over EUR 50,000.

events.name: Sagre estive di Orosei (summer food festivals)
events.blurb: Orosei hosts a series of traditional summer food festivals, including the Sagra del Dolce (sweets) and sagre of local breads such as pane lentu and purpuzza, with tastings of Sardinian cuisine, music and dance.

events.name: Festa di Sant'Antonio di Padova
events.blurb: A major annual religious festival shared by Arbus, Guspini and the hamlet of Sant'Antonio di Santadi, featuring one of the longest processions in the region with horsemen, folk groups and ox-drawn carts, plus communal meals, live music and fireworks. In 2026 it runs June 13-16.

events.name: S'Atobiu de is Tracas
events.blurb: A traditional parade of decorated children's carts (tracas) held in Arbus, with an exhibition of cart models and evening entertainment, closing the Sant'Antonio festival period.

events.name: Sagra del Cinghiale (Wild Boar Festival)
events.blurb: A local food festival in Arbus celebrating wild boar, a traditional dish of the inland Sardinian countryside, with tastings and community events.

events.name: Focs de Sant Joan (Feast of St John the Baptist)
events.blurb: Alghero celebrates its patron saint and the summer solstice with the lighting of St John's bonfires (Focs de Sant Joan) on the beach, alongside ancient rites, a midnight swim, music and food stalls that mark the start of the summer season.

events.name: Settimana Santa di Alghero (Holy Week)
events.when: annually during Holy Week; 2026: 27 March - 12 April
events.blurb: Alghero's Holy Week rites, rooted in centuries-old Spanish Catalan traditions, feature solemn processions across the old town, culminating in the Good Friday procession and concluding with fireworks on Holy Saturday.

events.name: Bogamari (Sea Urchin) Festival
events.blurb: A traditional sea urchin food festival held on Alghero's Lungomare Barcellona every weekend in March, celebrating the local 'bogamari' (sea urchin) cuisine with stalls and tastings.

events.name: Cap d'Any (New Year and Christmas season)
events.blurb: Alghero's festive season runs from late November to Epiphany, with a Santa's village, Christmas markets, an ice rink, street performances and New Year's Eve celebrations across the city.

events.name: Festa di San Bartolomeo
events.blurb: Lampedusa celebrates its apostle San Bartolomeo with religious rites, a procession, the traditional lighting of a wooden-pyramid bonfire recalling the saint's martyrdom, and evening fireworks over the port.

events.name: Festa della Madonna di Porto Salvo
events.when: annually, culminating on 22 September (processions begin the first Sunday of September)
events.blurb: The feast of Lampedusa's patron, the Madonna di Porto Salvo, protector of fishermen, includes a sea procession of fishing boats, processions through the streets, and concludes with a fish festival (Sagra del Pesce), band concerts and fireworks.

events.name: Maxi Yacht Rolex Cup
events.blurb: The premier international maxi yacht regatta, organised by the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda in Porto Cervo with racing across the La Maddalena Archipelago. The 2026 edition is its 36th.

events.name: Porto Cervo Wine & Food Festival
events.when: annually in spring (2026 edition held May 7-10)
events.blurb: A major Italian wine and gastronomy festival held in Porto Cervo, gathering around 60 wine and spirits exhibitors plus food producers. The 2026 edition was the 15th.

events.name: Lu Carrasciali Alzachinesu (Arzachena Carnival)
events.blurb: One of Gallura's most distinctive Carnival celebrations, featuring allegorical floats, masked groups and around a thousand performers in parades spanning Arzachena's old town and the villages of Porto Cervo and Cannigione.

events.name: Costa Smeralda Summer Events (Porto Cervo)
events.blurb: A summer-long programme of free events organised by the Costa Smeralda Consortium in Porto Cervo, including concerts, exhibitions, a literary review (Porto Cervo Libri), children's shows and evenings of Sardinian tradition.

events.name: Festa di San Sebastiano Martire
events.blurb: Arbus honours its patron saint San Sebastiano with a multi-day program of religious processions, bonfires, music, choirs, square dances and fireworks. The 2026 edition runs 16-24 January.

events.name: Festa di Sant'Antonio di Santadi
events.blurb: A major religious festival shared by Arbus, Guspini and the Sant'Antonio di Santadi hamlet, featuring one of the longest and most evocative processions in the area, plus street food, music and pyrotechnic shows.

events.name: Sagra della Pecora Nera di Arbus
events.when: annually the last weekend of July
events.blurb: A multi-day food festival in the Arbus countryside dedicated to the local 'pecora nera' (black sheep) breed, with tastings, workshops, debates and demonstrations of traditional Sardinian cuisine.

events.name: Festa della Madonna d'Itria (Nostra Signora d'Itria)
events.blurb: A traditional religious feast in Arbus dedicated to Nostra Signora d'Itria, combining processions and church rites with community celebrations.

events.name: Festa di San Giovanni Battista (Patron Saint Festival)
events.blurb: Siniscola's main patron saint festival, held in the town centre with numerous stalls selling traditional food and drink, concerts and religious and civil events.

events.name: Sant'Antonio Abate (Su Ramasinu)
events.blurb: Traditional festival featuring the lighting of a large rosemary and cistus bonfire in the town square, accompanied by traditional sweets, wine and the local fava bean dish (Sa Favata).

events.name: Stella Maris (Capo Comino)
events.blurb: Coastal celebration at Capo Comino, near the Berchida area, with vendor stalls and concerts honouring the Madonna of the sea.

events.name: Nostra Signora delle Grazie
events.blurb: One of Siniscola's largest celebrations, a multi-day event drawing thousands of people, with games, food stalls and traditional Sardinian Tenores singing and polyphonic choirs.

events.name: Festa a Mare agli Scogli di Sant'Anna
events.blurb: Ischia's most famous folk festival, held each 26 July in the Cartaromana bay beside the Aragonese Castle, just along the coast from Spiaggia dei Pescatori. A parade of decorated boats representing the island's municipalities competes for a prize, followed by a theatrical 'burning' of the castle and a large fireworks display.

events.name: Ischia Film Festival
events.blurb: An annual international film competition focused on cinematic locations, held in the 16th-century Aragonese Castle near Ischia Ponte. The 24th edition is scheduled for 27 June to 4 July 2026.

events.name: Festa di San Lussorio
events.when: annually mid-to-late August (around the third Sunday)
events.blurb: Tortolì's patron-saint feast honoring the 4th-century martyr San Lussorio, with solemn masses, a procession bearing the saint's statue, the traditional ox-yoke 'S'Imbidu' auction, folklore dances, concerts, food stands of Ogliastra dishes and fireworks in the historic center.

events.name: Carnevale di Tortolì
events.blurb: Carnival celebrations in Tortolì featuring traditional Sardinian masks, including visiting groups such as S'Urtzu e sa Mamulada di Seui, Mamutzones de Samugheo and the Bois of Escalaplano.

events.name: Rocce Rosse Blues Festival
events.blurb: Long-running blues and music festival named after the Rocce Rosse (Red Rocks) of Arbatax in Tortolì, where its first editions were staged; it has hosted artists such as David Bowie, Eric Clapton and Patti Smith and now tours venues across Ogliastra and Sardinia each summer.

events.name: Sa Festa Antiga
events.blurb: A spring event in Tortolì recreating traditional life of old Ogliastra, with artisanal crafts, sea heritage and local food and flavors.

events.name: Festa di Santa Maria Maddalena (Patron Saint Feast)
events.blurb: The most important annual event on La Maddalena, honoring the town's patron saint Saint Mary Magdalene with a religious procession plus civil celebrations including outdoor music, sporting events and folk entertainment in the days around 22 July.

events.name: Commemoration of Giuseppe Garibaldi's Death at Caprera
events.blurb: An annual ceremony at Giuseppe Garibaldi's tomb at the Compendio Garibaldino on Caprera (the island where Spiaggia del Relitto is located), with civil and military authorities, an armed guard of honor, the local band and floral wreaths marking the anniversary of his death.

events.name: VELA Cup La Maddalena
events.blurb: A popular amateur sailing regatta held in the waters of the La Maddalena archipelago, drawing many boats to race in one of the Mediterranean's most scenic settings, with social events ashore.

events.name: Regata della Vela Latina (Raduno dei 45)
events.blurb: Stintino is regarded as Italy's capital of lateen-sail (vela latina) sailing and hosts the country's most important regatta of these traditional boats. The associated 'Raduno dei 45' commemorates the 45 families exiled from Asinara who founded Stintino in 1885.

events.name: Festa della Beata Vergine della Difesa
events.blurb: Stintino's three-day patronal feast of the Blessed Virgin of Defence, during which a procession carries the statue of the Madonna to the sea aboard a fleet of local fishing boats, laying a laurel wreath in memory of those lost at sea.

events.name: Estate Stintinese (Stintino Summer events)
events.blurb: Stintino's official summer programme of concerts, cultural evenings and events held throughout the village during the high season.

events.name: Focs de Sant Joan (Feast of San Giovanni Battista)
events.blurb: Alghero's midsummer feast for Saint John the Baptist, with bonfires (focs) lit in the historic centre and ancient seashore rituals tied to the solstice. The Catalan-rooted celebration includes music, traditions and dawn bathing in the sea.

events.name: Jazz Alguer Festival
events.blurb: A long-running jazz festival held across Alghero from late spring through autumn, with concerts staged in atmospheric venues such as wineries, squares and archaeological sites. It is one of the most respected events on the Italian jazz scene.

events.name: Sant Miquel Festival
events.when: annually late September to early October
events.blurb: Alghero's festival honouring its patron saint San Michele (Sant Miquel in Catalan), with several days of concerts, exhibitions and food events in the old town. It marks the end of the summer season.

events.name: Cap d'Any de l'Alguer
events.when: annually late November through 6 January, with New Year's Eve concerts
events.blurb: Alghero's winter and New Year celebration featuring open-air concerts, street theatre, markets, an ice rink and a Santa's Village. The Catalan-named festival culminates in a large New Year's Eve event in the city.

events.name: Festival della Maiolica
events.blurb: A ceramics and arts festival spanning the 'Baia della Ceramica' coast between Savona, Albissola Marina, Albisola Superiore and Celle Ligure, with over fifty exhibitions, installations, workshops and guided tours. Albissola Marina hosts highlights including the open-air 'Cena in Bianco e Blu' communal dinner in the historic centre.

events.name: Buongiorno Ceramica!
events.blurb: National celebration of Italy's ceramic cities, held in around 60 towns; in Albissola Marina (a historic ceramics centre) it brings open workshops, installations and exhibitions, with the 2026 edition themed on water.

events.name: Festa Patronale di Nostra Signora della Concordia (Nativity of the Virgin Mary)
events.blurb: Albissola Marina's patron-saint feast on 8 September, dedicated to the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary, with religious celebrations centred on the Church of Nostra Signora della Concordia and a long communal table filling the pedestrian historic centre.

events.name: Il Natale delle Albisole (Christmas events)
events.blurb: Christmas-season programme across Albissola Marina and Albisola Superiore, including the inauguration of the nativity scene (presepe) at the Church of N.S. della Concordia and festive activities in the town centre.

events.name: Festa di San Giacomo (Festa del Pescatore)
events.blurb: Porto Azzurro honours its patron saint San Giacomo on 25 July with the traditional Festa del Pescatore (Fisherman's Festival), when the village is decorated as an old maritime town with food stands and a period-costume re-enactment of the saint's life.

events.name: Notte Azzurra
events.blurb: An August summer night festival when the streets of Porto Azzurro fill with live music and entertainment until late, and the main square becomes a large open-air dance venue.

events.name: Festeggiamenti della Madonna di Monserrato
events.blurb: Celebrations of the Madonna di Monserrato run from 2 to 8 September, with a historical and cultural focus that highlights the heritage of traditions inherited from the Spanish crown that once ruled the area.

events.name: Processione di San Carmine e Palio Remiero
events.blurb: A religious procession in honour of San Carmine held in mid-July, accompanied by a traditional rowing race (palio remiero) in the harbour of Porto Azzurro.

events.name: Feast of Sant'Efisio (Festa di Sant'Efisio)
events.blurb: Cagliari's most important traditional festival, held every May 1-4 since 1657 to fulfill a vow made during the 1652 plague. A multi-day procession in regional dress carries the statue of Sant'Efisio from Cagliari to Nora and back.

events.name: Poetto Fest
events.when: annually late May / early June 2026 (May 29 - June 1)
events.blurb: An open-air music festival on Cagliari's coast featuring dozens of Italian artists across rap, pop, dance and urban genres. The 2026 edition runs four days at the Arena Village near the beach with views toward the Sella del Diavolo headland.

events.name: World Triathlon Championship Series Cagliari
events.when: annually (recent editions held in Cagliari at Poetto beach)
events.blurb: An elite international triathlon round held in Cagliari, with the swim leg staged off Poetto beach near the Sella del Diavolo and Sant'Elia promontory close to Calamosca. The Olympic-format race features a 1,500m swim, 40km bike and 10km run.

spiaggia-di-cavoli.town: Marina di Campo (Campo nell'Elba), Elba Island, Tuscany

events.name: Festa Patronale di San Gaetano
events.blurb: Marina di Campo celebrates its patron saint San Gaetano every August 7th with a solemn Mass, an evening procession carrying the saint's statue through the town and onto the sea, live music in Piazza della Vittoria, and a midnight fireworks display over the gulf.

events.name: Sagra del Totano
events.blurb: A gastronomic festival organized by the Amici del Porto association at Marina di Campo, held over two days in November, celebrating locally caught squid (totano) with food stands at the harbour.

events.name: Carnevale di Fano
events.blurb: One of the oldest carnivals in Italy, documented since 1347, with allegorical float parades, the famous 'Getto' (throwing of sweets from the floats) and the closing Rogo del Pupo. It draws around 100,000 visitors each year.

events.name: BrodettoFest
events.when: annually late May/early June (2026: May 30 - June 2)
events.blurb: A seafood-cuisine festival on Fano's waterfront (Lido) celebrating the local 'brodetto' fish soup, with a Taste Village, cooking competitions, food stands, shows and music. The 2026 edition is the 24th.

events.name: La Fano dei Cesari
events.blurb: A historical reenactment recreating Roman-era Fanum Fortunae, with costumed parades, Roman camps, gladiator displays and a chariot race (corsa delle bighe) between the city's four factions.

events.name: Sopravènto
events.blurb: A music-and-sea festival in Fano with live performances by Italian artists, including a free sunrise concert on the Spiaggia Sassonia / Largo Rastatt beachfront.

spiaggia-di-fetovaia.town: Marina di Campo (Campo nell'Elba, Elba Island)

events.name: Festa di San Gaetano (Patronal Festival of Marina di Campo)
events.blurb: Marina di Campo, the main town near Fetovaia beach, celebrates its patron saint San Gaetano each August 7 with sailing regattas in the bay, a Holy Mass and street procession, a sea procession carrying the saint's statue on a fishing boat to bless the gulf, and a fireworks display over the sea at midnight.

events.name: Festa di San Lorenzo (Patron Festival of Seccheto)
events.blurb: Seccheto, the village immediately neighbouring Fetovaia, celebrates its patron San Lorenzo with a traditional festa around 10 August. It is the closest community festival to the Fetovaia beach.

events.name: Corsa degli Asini (Donkey Race), Marina di Campo
events.when: annually on the third Sunday of January
events.blurb: A traditional and humorous donkey race held in Marina di Campo on the third Sunday of January, a long-running local winter folklore event in the Campo nell'Elba area.

events.name: Festa di Sant'Antonio di Santadi
events.blurb: Religious feast where the statue of Sant'Antonio is carried from Arbus by an ox-drawn cart to the Sant'Antonio di Santadi hamlet, in one of the longest processions in Europe, with field blessings, street food and fireworks.

events.name: Festa di San Sebastiano Martire
events.blurb: Patron-saint celebration in Arbus; on the eve, bonfires are lit in the town's main neighbourhoods and local products are shared among the community.

events.name: Sagra della Pecora Nera di Arbus
events.blurb: Food festival celebrating Arbus's black sheep, with tastings of locally raised sheep meat cooked according to traditional methods.

events.name: Festa di San Lussorio Martire
events.blurb: The feast in honour of San Lussorio Martire, formerly the town's patron saint, is Arbus's biggest annual celebration, held around the saint's liturgical day in late August.

spiaggia-di-li-cossi.town: Trinità d'Agultu e Vignola (Costa Paradiso / Isola Rossa), Sardinia

events.name: Festa della Musica e Yoga Day - Isola Rossa
events.blurb: On the summer solstice the waterfront of Isola Rossa (the coastal village of Trinità d'Agultu e Vignola) hosts a free open-air musical marathon with over 20 artists and DJ sets from late afternoon to midnight, paired with a yoga and sound-bath session. Organized by the Municipality and Pro Loco Territorio Costa Rossa.

events.name: Festa della Birra Trinitàiese (Trinitàiese Beer Festival)
events.blurb: A long-running beer festival held over the Ferragosto weekend in Trinità d'Agultu, reaching its 27th edition in 2025. It combines craft beer, street food and Gallura specialities with live music and popular traditions.

events.name: Festa Patronale della Santissima Trinità
events.blurb: The patron saint feast of Trinità d'Agultu e Vignola, dedicated to the Holy Trinity from which the town takes its name, celebrated annually in early June.

spiaggia-di-mari-ermi.town: Cabras (Sinis Peninsula, Province of Oristano, Sardinia)

events.name: Corsa degli Scalzi (Festa di San Salvatore)
events.when: annually, first weekend of September (celebrations late August to early September)
events.blurb: A centuries-old religious festival in which hundreds of barefoot men dressed in white robes (curridoris) run about seven kilometres carrying the simulacrum of San Salvatore from the parish church in Cabras to the village of San Salvatore di Sinis. It commemorates a 1619 race to protect the statue from coastal raiders and is one of Sardinia's most famous traditions.

events.name: Festival della Bottarga - Alchimie di Gusto
events.blurb: A food festival in Cabras celebrating the town's prized bottarga di muggine (cured grey mullet roe), with tastings, chef demonstrations and cultural events. The 2025 edition ran 19-21 September and drew over 10,000 visitors.

events.name: Focs de Sant Joan
events.blurb: Alghero's traditional Catalan-identity festival for St John's Eve, culminating on the night of 23 June on San Giovanni beach with bonfires and the ritual fire-jumping, with participants dressed in white. Four days of folklore, music and processions through the historic centre.

events.name: Alguer Summer Festival
events.when: annually late July to August (2026: 25 July - 23 August)
events.blurb: Major summer concert series held at the Ivan Graziani Amphitheater in Alghero, drawing leading Italian artists. The 2026 line-up includes Blanco, Caparezza, Madame, Mannarino and Tommaso Paradiso.

events.name: JazzAlguer
events.blurb: Recurring jazz festival staged in Alghero as part of the city's Alghero Experience summer programme, featuring Italian and international jazz performers.

events.name: Birralguer (Beer Festival)
events.blurb: Alghero's craft beer festival, a returning fixture of the city's summer Alghero Experience calendar combining beer, street food and live entertainment.

events.name: Sagra della Tellina (Clam Festival)
events.blurb: A long-running food festival (60th edition in 2025) at the Borghetto dei Pescatori fishing village in Ostia, where roughly 40 quintals of telline (wedge clams) are cooked in traditional Roman style alongside live music and stands. It includes the 'Marriage with the Sea' maritime procession honouring the Madonna Stella Maris, protectress of fishermen.

events.name: Festa di Sant'Agostino, patron saint of Ostia
events.blurb: Ostia celebrates its patron, Saint Augustine of Hippo, who stayed in ancient Ostia where his mother Saint Monica died in 387. The civic and religious ceremony includes floral tributes and blessing of his statue, plus readings from the Confessions in Piazza Anco Marzio.

events.name: Rievocazione Storica del Toson d'Oro
events.blurb: A historical re-enactment held in Vasto's old town since 1986, commemorating the 1723 awarding of the Order of the Golden Fleece. Hundreds of participants in Baroque and Renaissance costumes parade with flag-throwers, musicians and performers.

events.name: Festa di San Michele Arcangelo (Patron Saint Feast)
events.blurb: Vasto's patron saint celebration honoring San Michele Arcangelo, with religious services and a procession centered on the Church of Santa Maria Maggiore, alongside several days of music and popular events.

events.name: Estate Vastese (Vasto Summer Festival programme)
events.blurb: Vasto's official summer cultural programme spanning concerts, jazz (Vasto in Jazz), literary events (Vasto d'Autore), food festivals and the Dal Basso youth music festival. The town publishes the full lineup on its dedicated events portal each year.

events.name: Festa di Sant'Antonio Abate
events.blurb: Posada's patron saint feast, marked by a large communal bonfire of cistus brush with three processional circuits around the fire, followed by distribution of traditional sweets (sos cogoneddos, s'aranzada) and roasted sausage with wine.

events.name: Festa Santu Juanne 'e Mare (San Giovanni)
events.blurb: Summer-solstice feast of St John celebrated near Posada's coast, blending religious procession with the Sardinian fire rite of the fogarones and concerts/performances during the festivities.

events.name: Festa della Madonna del Soccorso
events.when: annually, the first Sunday after Easter
events.blurb: Considered the principal local feast in Posada, celebrated on the first Sunday after Easter with religious and community festivities.

events.name: Festa di San Michele (santuario campestre)
events.blurb: A rural festival held at the country sanctuary of San Michele near Posada at the end of September.

the-pink-beach.town: La Maddalena (Budelli island, La Maddalena Archipelago, Sardinia)

events.name: Festa di Santa Maria Maddalena (Patron Saint Festival)
events.blurb: La Maddalena's main patronal feast honors its patron saint with a week of cultural, sporting and musical events, culminating on 22 July in a religious procession from the church of Santa Maria Maddalena to the port of Cala Gavetta, a flotilla of boats carrying the statue out to sea, and a fireworks finale over the waterfront.

events.name: VELA Cup La Maddalena
events.blurb: A non-competitive sailing regatta open to all boat classes, organized by Giornale della Vela with the Municipality of La Maddalena, running through the waters of the La Maddalena Archipelago National Park.

events.name: Premio Solinas a La Maddalena
events.blurb: Italy's leading screenwriting award turns La Maddalena into an open-air laboratory for cinema, with masterclasses, pitching sessions and film screenings drawing established and emerging screenwriters and producers to the island each September.

events.name: Commemorazione della corazzata Roma
events.blurb: A solemn naval commemoration at La Maddalena remembering the roughly 1,850 sailors lost when the battleship Roma and the destroyers De Noli and Vivaldi were sunk after the 8 September 1943 armistice, marked by a memorial ceremony and a wreath cast into the sea.

events.name: Sagra del Ranocchio (Frog Festival), Vada
events.when: annually, late June to mid-August (multiple weekends)
events.blurb: A long-running seaside food festival in Vada, the coastal hamlet adjacent to Spiagge Bianche, serving fried frogs, frogs in broth and fried fish with evening dance music. Held over several weekends at Campo del Mare Silvio Gori near the shore.

events.name: Sagra del Baccala e dello Stoccafisso, Rosignano Marittimo
events.when: annually in late July (around the 4th weekend)
events.blurb: A four-day salt cod and stockfish food festival at Area Feste L'Oliveta in Rosignano Marittimo, with gastronomic stands of sea and countryside dishes and free evening live music. The 2025 edition was the ninth, held 24-27 July.

events.name: Sagra del Favollo (Heart Crab Festival)
events.blurb: A traditional village festival in the Rosignano Marittimo area featuring simple Tuscan coastal cuisine tastings and folk entertainment, centred on the local favollo (heart crab).
